observations: Model used fill without enable_autocomplete_menu=True on the Assigned to reference textbox.
Before Run, the displayed value was the requested person and the autocomplete combobox was not expanded.
After Run, the delivered breadcrumb read Assigned to = (empty).
The model then repeated a click on that breadcrumb; no response answer was supplied.
mechanism_hypothesis: The displayed text was not resolved/selected as a reference record. BrowserGym default fill only sends input, while the upstream helper types a final character, waits for resolution and clicks an exact autocomplete option. A matched browser comparison is still needed to isolate the cause.
